top_signal.title: University campus festival booth ideas?
top_signal.summary: My university is hosting a festival in a couple of months, and students have the opportunity to set up their own booths/small businesses.   The festival is a huge hit every year, so I’m thinking of participating this year since it’s my last year as a student. The problem is I’m completely out of ideas   What would you actually buy from a booth at a university festival? I’m open to pretty much anything except food or drink since I don’t have a trade license yet.   I’m also lucky enough that my parents are encouraging me to try starting a small business and are willing to help me with the startup costs, so I do have some room to invest in a good idea rather than needing something with basically no upfront cost.   If you’ve done something like this before, I’d especially love to hear what actually sold well (or what you thought would sell but didn’t).   Any ideas?       submitted by     /u/mariamxiie       [link]       [comments]
